description: Umsatzsteuer-Voranmeldung (UStVA) estimate for a month, quarter or year: the form lines (Kennzahlen, 2026 form) with base and tax, e.g. Kz 81/86 domestic sales, 41 intra-EU supplies, 43 exports, 46/47 and 84/85 reverse charge (§13b), 89/93 acquisitions, 66/61/67 input VAT (Vorsteuer), plus the Kz 83 estimate, the Zusammenfassende Meldung (ZM) per buyer VAT id, OSS sales per country, and amounts it cannot place. Computed here from invoices, credit notes and vouchers (positions read one by one, up to 1,500 documents; slow for long periods). basis: accrual (Soll, default; sevDesk's API does not expose the account setting) or cash (Ist, from reconciled payments). It reads the account's tax regime itself (no need for sevdesk_account_info first); Kleinunternehmer accounts get no UStVA. An estimate to check, not a filing: submit via ELSTER.

year.description: Calendar year; alone for the whole year, or with month or quarter.
